news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.1% a week. This is considered a minor risk. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.45 (vs ₹0.29 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.45 (up from ₹0.29 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹2.07b (down 2.7% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹36.5m (up 91% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.8% (up from 0.9% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 76% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 19% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.title: Bannari Amman Spinning Mills Limited Appoints Sri R Shanmugavelayutham as Independent Director, Effective December 18, 2025
news.body: Bannari Amman Spinning Mills Limited appointed Sri R Shanmugavelayutham (DIN 01205640) as an Independent Director of the company by passing a Special Resolution. The appointment was approved by the members of the company through remote e-voting, with the results declared on December 18, 2025, being the last date of the remote e-voting. The scrutinizer's report was prepared by R Dhanasekaran, Company Secretary in Practice, and issued on December 18, 2025. The appointment was made in accordance with the Postal Ballot Notice dated November 14, 2025. The total number of shareholders on record date was 25,499.
